notes:
Account background: mid-stage agtech SaaS (precision recommendations for growers). Looking to move from prototype on public cloud to Dedicated capacity for production inference across field app (offline/low-connectivity) and internal analytics. Main goals: predictable per-request latency for short chat queries, guaranteed throughput during morning ingest windows, data residency for EU operations.

Summary of technical ask: baseline QPS and token/sec profiling, recommended reserved GPU counts (steady-state vs peak), SLO language for 95th/99th latency, fallback routing to smaller quantized variants under overload. Prefer H100 for large-model throughput; open to mixed pool (A100 for embeddings). Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit for guaranteed latency/throughput.

Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-21): "If we can't guarantee sub-300ms 95th for quick lookups, field agents will notice. We need a buffer for harvest windows when traffic spikes 3x."

POC plan proposed: 2-week dedicated-sizing workshop. Week 1: synthetic workload that mirrors morning ingest + field chat, measure tokens/sec and KV cache hit rates; bench Llama-3-13B and 70B quantized variants; run steady-state run and 3x peak spike. Week 2: tune batching, caching, and routing policies; produce recommended reserved GPU counts and an SLA addendum draft.

Preliminary sizing notes from AE/SE: baseline target = 45 QPS (chat) steady-state; average request = 120 tokens; target throughput = ~5.4k tokens/sec steady-state. Peak planning = 3x (135 QPS), reserve buffer = +20% => reserve capacity sized for ~162 QPS equivalent. Early bench suggests 8x H100 for steady and 12x H100 for peak+burst (subject to kernel selection and quantization strategy). Embeddings workload separated to A100 pool: target 250 QPS, batching aggressive.

Compliance/ops: require SSO (SAML), enterprise audit logs routed to their SIEM, KMS integration for model secrets, 7-year audit retention for specific telemetry (negotiable).

Commercial signals: procurement budget in Q2; legal reviewing SLA/data residency now. Next milestone: Redwood bench report + draft SLA by 2026-03-22.

CRM shorthand: 2/21 kickoff call; 3/5 deep-dive w/ infra engs; demo good fit for Dedicated + Optimize. AE: Samira. SE: Daniel. CSM flagged early to prep onboarding plan.
